# Document and ignore repository-local state roots generated by guided examples

## Intent

Document and ignore repository-local state roots generated by guided examples

## Affected Canonical Specs

- `aps-cli`

## Acceptance Criteria

- The repository ignores every local state root created by the guided examples, and the ignore policy is documented clearly.

## No-spec Rationale

This records repository hygiene for generated example state without changing the aps CLI contract.
